title: Payroll purpose and professional identity
topics: payroll analyst, consultant and architect roles
lab: Interview a fictional payroll manager and trace a late salary complaint from symptom to business impact
evidence: Personal learning charter and payroll service canvas
acceptance: Explain employee net pay versus employer total cost and name the accountable process owners

title: UK institutions and jurisdiction
topics: HMRC, The Pensions Regulator, employment policy, devolved income tax, Northern Ireland distinctions, UK versus Crown Dependencies
lab: Build a responsibility map for England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland; keep Ireland and Isle of Man outside the UK scope
evidence: Jurisdiction and regulator map with source register
acceptance: Separate tax jurisdiction, work location, residence and employing entity without assuming they are equivalent

title: Payslip and gross-to-net literacy
lab: Annotate a synthetic payslip and reconcile each line to a source event
evidence: Payslip explanation and arithmetic bridge
acceptance: Reconcile gross less deductions to net and explain why the calculation bases differ

title: Calendar and service rhythm
topics: weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly frequencies
lab: Design a calendar spanning a bank holiday and tax-year boundary
evidence: Payroll calendar and responsibility matrix
acceptance: Distinguish contractual payday, processing date, bank deadline and reporting deadline

title: Evidence and responsible experimentation
lab: Compare an old training slide with current guidance and record a corrected learning hypothesis
evidence: Evidence log and uncertainty register
acceptance: Every statutory claim has a URL, effective date, review date and owner

title: Payroll discovery and experience
topics: HR, Finance, Treasury and payroll handoffs
lab: Role-play a joiner, payroll analyst and CFO discovering failure points
evidence: Stakeholder interview guide and current-state journey
acceptance: Show at least five failure points with an owner, control and measurable outcome

title: SAP landscape and product choices
topics: SAP HCM Payroll, SAP HCM for SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll
lab: Compare two target landscapes and identify licences, access, release and responsibility boundaries
evidence: Product decision record and environment readiness checklist
acceptance: No assumption that EC, ECP, PCC or middleware is automatically licensed or activated

title: Organisation and payroll structures
lab: Design monthly salaried and weekly operational populations for OmniWorks UK
evidence: Organisation-to-payroll mapping and configuration workbook
acceptance: Explain grouping choices, reporting needs and transport dependencies before changing configuration

title: Employee lifecycle and master data
lab: Create synthetic joiner and leaver records, then introduce a backdated transfer
evidence: Data dictionary, lifecycle timeline and validation rules
acceptance: Distinguish business-effective date, replication date and payroll impact date

title: Time, absence and valuation
lab: Trace a shift worker's approved time and absence to proposed payroll inputs
evidence: Time-to-pay interface map and valuation examples
acceptance: Identify missing approvals, duplicate hours and policy assumptions without inventing a universal overtime rule

title: Payroll execution and control records
lab: Run or storyboard a payroll cycle containing one rejected employee
evidence: Cycle runbook and error triage log
acceptance: Show who can change data at each state and how failed employees are recovered

title: Reading results and reconciliation
topics: Earnings, deductions, employer costs, cumulative balances
lab: Explain two successive results with a salary change and compare totals
evidence: Result walkthrough and first reconciliation pack
acceptance: Every material variance links to an approved event or a documented defect

title: Wage-type engineering
lab: Design salary, overtime, bonus, deduction and benefit wage types in a sandbox
evidence: Wage-type catalogue and treatment decision table
acceptance: For each wage type, demonstrate expected bases and posting outcomes with positive and negative tests

title: Schemas and personnel calculation rules
lab: Trace a delivered calculation, then prototype one controlled allowance rule
evidence: Annotated schema trace, PCR specification and rollback plan
acceptance: Explain input, decision and output; compare standard behaviour before proposing a custom rule

title: PAYE and tax-code lifecycle
lab: Test a starter without P45, a new tax code and an in-year correction
evidence: PAYE scenario matrix and independently calculated expected results
acceptance: Use tax-year-specific guidance and preserve notice/source lineage; avoid treating a sample code as universal

title: National Insurance and directors
lab: Compare an ordinary employee, director and apprentice using controlled test inputs
evidence: NI decision table and boundary-test pack
acceptance: Test just below, at and above relevant thresholds and separate employee from employer calculations

title: Loans and ordered deductions
lab: Simulate a loan plan change and multiple ordered deductions with a low-net-pay case
evidence: Deduction priority design and remittance reconciliation
acceptance: Document the legal basis per order type and prevent unsupported generic priority assumptions

title: Regular, retroactive and exceptional pay
lab: Process a backdated salary increase and an emergency payment without duplicating payment or reporting
evidence: Retro explanation, exceptional-payment runbook and reconciliation
acceptance: Tie original and replacement results to net payment, statutory reporting and FI effects

title: Sickness and statutory family pay
topics: maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental, parental bereavement and neonatal care pay
eligibility, average earnings, overlaps and recovery
lab: Test a sickness case crossing April 2026 and a neonatal-care case alongside another family-pay entitlement
evidence: Statutory-pay decision trees, eligibility evidence and effective-date tests
acceptance: Keep SSP non-recoverable; distinguish parental-pay recovery; test transitional rules and installed SAP legal changes

title: Pensions and automatic enrolment
topics: net pay versus relief at source
lab: Process age and earnings changes, an opt-out and a backdated contribution correction
evidence: Assessment timeline, pension interface and contribution reconciliation
acceptance: Evidence assessment decisions, communications, contribution basis and provider acknowledgement

title: Benefits, expenses and salary sacrifice
lab: Compare a pension sacrifice, company car and taxable expense using current guidance
evidence: Benefit-treatment matrix and year-end responsibility map
acceptance: Separate current rules from announced future changes and test minimum-wage implications where applicable

title: Minimum wage, holiday and termination
lab: Investigate a low-paid worker's deduction and a leaver with multiple termination elements
evidence: Minimum-wage review and termination treatment specification
acceptance: Break termination components into their individual treatments rather than applying a blanket exemption

title: RTI and HMRC reconciliation
lab: Create a mock submission, reject an identifier and demonstrate controlled resubmission
evidence: RTI field lineage, submission register and correction playbook
acceptance: Evidence accepted acknowledgement as well as transmission; prevent duplicate reporting; use current SAP RTI documentation

title: Year-end and tax-year transition
lab: Rehearse a March/April transition with a leaver and benefit reconciliation
evidence: Year-end checklist and tax-year change regression pack
acceptance: Reconcile year-to-date values, employee outputs and statutory liabilities before sign-off

title: EC-to-payroll replication architecture
lab: Inject a missing mapping, duplicate event and out-of-order effective date
evidence: Field mapping, sequence diagram and recovery evidence
acceptance: Choose the supported integration pattern for the actual release; do not assume CPI is mandatory for every EC-to-ECP integration

title: Finance, Treasury and payment integration
lab: Reconcile payroll totals to an FI journal and synthetic payment file; then reject one bank record
evidence: Posting specification, bank interface and four-way reconciliation
acceptance: Reconcile gross-to-net, bank net, FI balances and liabilities; payment format and Faster Payments depend on bank and service design

title: Security, privacy and resilient operations
lab: Threat-model a bank-account change and rehearse a failed payroll batch
evidence: Access matrix, threat model and recovery runbook
acceptance: Separate HR master-data access, payroll processing, payment release and technical administration

title: Migration, testing and parallel runs
lab: Migrate a synthetic mid-year population and explain every difference against a controlled baseline
evidence: Migration reconciliation, defect log and signed test pack
acceptance: Zero unexplained critical differences; business-approved rounding tolerances; no balancing totals that conceal employee errors

title: Cutover and operational transition
lab: Run a tabletop cutover with a replication outage near the payment deadline
evidence: Timed cutover plan, decision log and support handover
acceptance: Named owners approve payroll, bank release, RTI and FI; recovery feasibility is assessed after external submission

title: Payroll Control Center and AMS
lab: Design alerts for abnormal net pay and missing tax data; role-play an urgent payroll incident
evidence: Control catalogue, incident evidence pack and AMS acceptance criteria
acceptance: Alert thresholds have owners and false-positive review; distinguish business rule defects from technical outages

title: Enterprise payroll architecture
lab: Defend a UK payroll target architecture to a fictional CHRO, CFO and security lead
evidence: Architecture dossier with alternatives, constraints and decisions
acceptance: Explain service ownership, data authority, failure handling, observability and product-specific limits

title: Specialist and sector pathways
lab: Choose one sector and identify specialist advice and integration dependencies
evidence: Sector extension backlog and applicability assessment
acceptance: Treat CIS subcontractor processing and maritime/expatriate rules as specialist scope requiring verified product support

title: Analytics and service improvement
lab: Build a synthetic KPI dashboard and investigate a rising retro-adjustment rate
evidence: Metrics dictionary and improvement experiment
acceptance: Define numerator, denominator, owner and data lineage; measure effects before and after a controlled change

title: AI-assisted payroll with human control
lab: Prototype a payroll-policy assistant using synthetic questions and test misleading or outdated prompts
evidence: Evaluation dataset, failure log and approval workflow
acceptance: No autonomous changes to pay, bank files or HMRC submissions; demonstrate correct escalation when evidence is missing

title: Legal-change and release engineering
lab: Build a change-impact analysis for a new tax year and a statutory-pay update
evidence: Legal-change register and release evidence pack
acceptance: Every rule change links to authority, applicable SAP delivery, test cases and approval; announced changes remain flagged until effective

title: Practice leadership and professional portfolio
lab: Present a ten-minute payroll transformation proposal and teach a difficult concept to a peer
evidence: Portfolio index, demonstration recording and personal development roadmap
acceptance: Defend assumptions, show original evidence and explain limitations without claiming SAP certification
